goal: Determine the smallest build-from-owned architecture for adding the public Arcanum subagent-strategy lifecycle to Augmentor, so ordinary-language multi-agent requests become previewable, explicitly confirmable, concurrently executable, resumable, and safely degradable through current ResonantOS owners without importing DomainSpec private authority or creating a second scheduler, registry, or session store.
context: An accepted Augmentor routing and session blueprint already defines thread-local interactions, immutable route decisions, owner-correlated runs, notifications, and a two-child subagent-strategy plus Whisper witness. Public Arcanum owns the reusable subagent lifecycle, while DomainSpec owns private schema, pool, registrar, ledger, and artifact bindings; current ResonantOS owns threads, goals, compute, delegation, workspaces, artifacts, provider routing, permissions, and persistence but still has one global transient chat run. Research must verify the exact adapter, runtime, user-control, degraded-mode, and acceptance boundaries and produce an implementation-usable blueprint, not code or promotion.
